audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for foot washing, Judas, Peter, cleansing/participation, example of service, beloved disciple, morsel, Satan/adversarial entry, new commandment, Peter denial.

verses.restored: Before the feast of Passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour had come to pass from this world to the Father, having loved his own in the world, loved them to the end/completion.

familiar.text: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

verses.restored: During supper, when the adversarial impulse had already put into the heart of Judas son of Simon Iscariot to hand him over,

familiar.text: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;

verses.restored: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from the Divine and was going to the Divine,

familiar.text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

verses.restored: rises from supper, lays aside his garments, and taking a towel, tied it around himself.

familiar.text: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

verses.restored: Then he pours water into the basin and began to wash the disciples' feet and wipe them with the towel tied around him.

familiar.text: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

verses.restored: He comes therefore to Simon Peter. He says to him, Lord, do you wash my feet?

familiar.text: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to him, What I am doing you do not know now, but you will know after these things.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

verses.restored: Peter says to him, You will certainly never wash my feet into the age. Jesus answered him, Unless I wash you, you have no share with me.

familiar.text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

verses.restored: Simon Peter says to him, Lord, not my feet only, but also the hands and the head.

familiar.text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

verses.restored: Jesus says to him, The one bathed has no need except to wash the feet, but is wholly clean; and you are clean, but not all.

familiar.text: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

verses.restored: For he knew the one handing him over; because of this he said, Not all of you are clean.

familiar.text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

verses.restored: When therefore he had washed their feet, taken his garments, and reclined again, he said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?

familiar.text: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

verses.restored: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you speak beautifully/well, for I am.

familiar.text: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

verses.restored: If I then, the Lord and Teacher, washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

familiar.text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

verses.restored: For I gave you an example, so that just as I did to you, you also may do.

familiar.text: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: a servant is not greater than the lord, nor a sent one greater than the one who sent him.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

verses.restored: If you know these things, blessed/flourishing are you if you do them.

familiar.text: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

verses.restored: I do not speak concerning all of you; I know whom I chose. But so that the Scripture may be fulfilled: The one eating my bread lifted his heel against me.

familiar.text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.restored: From now I tell you before it happens, so that when it happens you may trust that I am.

familiar.text: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: the one receiving whomever I send receives me, and the one receiving me receives the One who sent me.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

verses.restored: Having said these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit and bore witness, saying, Amen, amen, I say to you that one of you will hand me over.

familiar.text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.restored: The disciples were looking at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

familiar.text: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

verses.restored: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was reclining close to the chest of Jesus.

familiar.text: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

verses.restored: Simon Peter therefore gestures to this one to ask who it might be about whom he speaks.

familiar.text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

verses.restored: Leaning back thus upon the chest of Jesus, he says to him, Lord, who is it?

familiar.text: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

verses.restored: Jesus answers, It is that one for whom I will dip the morsel and give it to him. Dipping the morsel, he takes and gives it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.

familiar.text: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.restored: After the morsel, the adversarial force entered into that one. Jesus therefore says to him, What you do, do quickly.

familiar.text: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

verses.restored: No one reclining knew for what purpose he said this to him.

familiar.text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

verses.restored: Some thought, since Judas had the money box, that Jesus was saying, Buy what we need for the feast, or that he should give something to the poor.

familiar.text: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

verses.restored: Receiving the morsel, that one went out immediately. And it was night.

familiar.text: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

verses.restored: When therefore he had gone out, Jesus says, Now the Son of Humanity has been glorified, and the Divine has been glorified in him.

familiar.text: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

verses.restored: If the Divine has been glorified in him, the Divine will also glorify him in himself, and will glorify him immediately.

familiar.text: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

verses.restored: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You will seek me; and just as I said to the Judeans, Where I go you are not able to come, I now say also to you.

familiar.text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

verses.restored: A new commandment I give to you: that you love one another; just as I loved you, so you also love one another.

familiar.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

verses.restored: By this all will know that you are my disciples, if you have love among one another.

familiar.text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

verses.restored: Simon Peter says to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, Where I go you are not able to follow me now, but you will follow later.

familiar.text: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

verses.restored: Peter says to him, Lord, why am I not able to follow you now? I will lay down my life/soul for you.

familiar.text: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

verses.restored: Jesus answers, Will you lay down your life/soul for me? Amen, amen, I say to you, a rooster will certainly not sound until you deny me three times.

familiar.text: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
